description.content:
Retrieves assigned consignments for a subcontractor from a specific Kuehne+Nagel Intermodal department.

**Note:** A 204 No Content response (with no body) is returned when there are no new or updated consignments available. Refer to the API Guide in the Documents section for details.

description.content: Submits proof of delivery for a specific waypoint.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier of the assigned consignment job. This value can be found in consignment.job.id from the AssignedConsignment response.
(Required) Unique identifier of the assigned consignment job waypoint. This value can be found in consignment.job.waypoint.id from the AssignedConsignment response.

header.description: (Required) Unique country identifier for a specific Kuehne+Nagel Operating Company.
(Required) UUID identifying the request which will be generated by the client.

formdata.description: (Required) Indicates whether the Proof of Delivery was signed digitally on a touchscreen device. Set this to false when submitting a scanned paper document without any associated metadata.
(Required) Date and time when the Proof of Delivery was recorded, expressed in local time, formatted as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss[+/-HH:mm].
(Required) Unique internal identifier of the message sender. This must be same as consignment.recipientUniqueShortName from the AssignedConsignment response.
(Required) A unique reference of Kuehne+Nagel's transport order. This is the same as the consignment.job.uniqueTransportReference from the AssignedConsignment response.
Name of the person who signed the Proof of Delivery.

Image of the signature captured by the person receiving or releasing the shipment during the delivery or pickup. This must be shared in case of captured via a Signed on Glass (digital signature). Must have: a size of max. 2 MB and a supported file extension: png, jpeg/jpg, bmp.

Content of the proof of delivery document (preferably a PDF), provided when the POD is a physically scanned copy and not captured via a Signed on Glass (digital signature). Must have: a size of max. 5 MB and a supported file extension: pdf, png, jpeg/jpg.
Any observations noted by receiver during delivery or pickup.

description.content:
This API enables Intermodal subcontractors who transport containers via truck, rail, and barge for Kuehne+Nagel to receive details about assigned consignments, including job details and instructions. It also allows them to provide status updates and proof of pickup/delivery on these consignments.
To use this API, subcontractors must be registered and set up as an API user  within our Intermodal TMS. Please discuss registration with your Kuehne+Nagel Intermodal operations point of contact.
